requirements.verbatim_text: The offeror shall submit Volume I (Technical) not to exceed twenty (20) pages.
Text shall be single-spaced, 12-point Times New Roman, with one-inch margins.
Proposals shall be submitted via email to the Contract Specialist no later than 2:00 PM Eastern Time on the closing date.
The offeror shall describe its technical approach to each task in PWS Section 3.
The offeror shall provide three (3) past performance references for contracts of similar size and scope performed within the last five (5) years.
The Government will evaluate the soundness and feasibility of the offeror's technical approach.
Past performance will be evaluated for recency, relevancy, and quality.
The offeror shall complete the representation at FAR 52.204-24 regarding covered telecommunications equipment.
Invoices shall be submitted monthly in arrears.
